entries.english:
Miscellaneous matters concerning the jointly held village of Vorbachzimmern (belonging to the Hohenlohe-Neuenstein affairs).

Term: (1481, 1517) 1639–1662

Contents:
1. Fol. 5–7: Würzburg, 12 September 1481 (Wednesday after the Nativity of Our Lady). Kilian von Bibra, cathedral provost of Würzburg, gives judgment in the dispute between the plaintiffs Lienhardt and Wilhelm Wernitzer, called Beheim, of Rothenburg and the Charterhouse of Tückelhausen and the community of Vorbachzimmern concerning the fruit tithes and keeping of breeding livestock at Vorbachzimmern. Seal: the issuer. Copy.
2. Fol. 12–14: 8 March 1517 (Sunday after Invocavit). Hans Wilhelm Wernitzer, called Beheim, of Rothenburg sells his quarter share of the tithe at Vorbachzimmern to Zaisolph von Rosenberg, Amtmann zu Jagstberg, for 560 florins. Seals: 1. the issuer; 2. Carl vom Rein; 3. Peter von Premen. Copy.
3. Fol. 16–25: Register of war expenses incurred for Vorbachzimmern and contributions delivered from Vorbachzimmern to Haltenbergstetten, 1643–1654.

Extent: 1 volume, fol. 1–37.
